# Pascal Anything

> Rewrite an app in Free Pascal / Lazarus one piece at a time, checked against the original at every step. Conceptual port of rust-anything: record what the original does, replay every case against the Pascal port. Done when `pascal-anything gate` passes. MIT OR Apache-2.0.

## Install

Linux/macOS: `./scripts/build.sh` then `pascal-anything setup` and `pascal-anything doctor`.  
Windows: `.\scripts\build.ps1` then the same commands (`pascalanything.exe` if the shim is not on PATH).

Needs Free Pascal on PATH. Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS — see docs/platforms.md.

Lazarus (optional): install for your OS, or on Unix `fpclazup` into `$HOME/.local/fpclaz`.

## Prompt for a coding agent

Install Pascal Anything, run `pascal-anything setup`. Run `pascal-anything go -- <slow command>`, port `src/port.pas` as TASK.md says. Done when every recorded case matches and `pascal-anything gate` passes.

## Main commands

- `pascal-anything go` — pick a candidate unit and start the loop
- `pascal-anything record` — record original (Python runs the real module)
- `pascal-anything diff` / `gate` — prove the Pascal port
- `pascal-anything mcp` — MCP stdio tools (analyze, bridge, record, build, diff, gate, doctor, rules)
